description: Use this when the user asks whether a specific stock is a good investment or a good long-term investment, buy / hold / sell, worth it at this price, overvalued or undervalued, its moat, risks, dividend safety, financial health, whether it is halal, or 'what do you think of X'. Accepts a ticker or company name (e.g. 'NVDA', 'Coca-Cola', 'SAP'). Shows a compact card with invest-like's plain-language read: one summary sentence, four verdicts with the numbers behind them (is it profitable, growing, fairly priced, financially safe), strengths, risks and what to watch, short answers on value, moat, dividend safety and financial health, and the AAOIFI halal result. Every verdict comes from a fixed, published rule, the same as on invest-like.com. Covers 21,000+ stocks worldwide, refreshed daily. Call it first, then add your own context such as recent news.
